/* SystemMngMapper.selectInterfaceKey : InterfaceKey 조회 */ SELECT ENT_CODE ,CUSTOMER_CODE ,ACCESS_KEY ,USE_YN ,REGISTER_USER_ID ,REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,UPDATE_USER_ID ,UPDATE_DATE_TIME ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME_ENG FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = interface.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = interface.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS CUSTOMER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = interface.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = interface.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = interface.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = interface.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_INTERFACE_INFO interface WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = #{srchCustomerCode}

/* SystemMngMapper.selectDeliveryInterfaceList : 배송사 Interface List */
SELECT ENT_CODE , BOUND , CASE BOUND WHEN 'AIR' THEN '항공' WHEN 'SEA' THEN '해상' END AS BOUND_ENG , CUSTOMER_CODE , LOGISTICS_CODE
, CASE WHEN LOGISTICS_CODE IN ('ICN','KRINC') THEN '인천' WHEN LOGISTICS_CODE = 'KRPTK' THEN '평택' WHEN LOGISTICS_CODE = 'KRPUS' THEN '부산' WHEN LOGISTICS_CODE = 'KRKUV' THEN '군산' END AS LOGISTICS_NAME , USE_YN , TRACKING_KOREX_YN , TRACKING_EMS_YN , TRACKING_EPOST_YN , TRACKING_COPAS_YN , TRACKING_SMART_YN , TRACKING_LOGEN_YN , TRACKING_CHUNIL_YN , TRACKING_HANJIN_YN , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = REG_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , REG_DATE , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = UPD_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , UPD_DATE , TRACKING_LOTTE_YN
FROM TB_SMS_DELIVERY_COMP_INFO WHERE 1 = 1
AND ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode}
AND CUSTOMER_CODE = #{srchCustomerCode}
AND BOUND = #{srchBoundType}
AND USE_YN = #{srchUseYn}
AND ${srchDateGbn} >= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND ${srchDateGbn} < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CONVERT(DATE, #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat}))
AND TRACKING_KOREX_YN = 'Y'
AND TRACKING_EMS_YN = 'Y'
AND TRACKING_EPOST_YN = 'Y'
AND TRACKING_COPAS_YN = 'Y'
AND TRACKING_SMART_YN = 'Y'
AND TRACKING_LOGEN_YN = 'Y'
AND TRACKING_CHUNIL_YN = 'Y'
AND TRACKING_HANJIN_YN = 'Y'

/* SystemMngMapper.selectDeliveryInterface : 배송사 Interface 조회(Entry) */ SELECT info.ENT_CODE , info.CUSTOMER_CODE , info.BOUND , CASE info.BOUND WHEN 'AI' THEN '항공수입' WHEN 'AO' THEN '항공수출' WHEN 'OI' THEN '해상수입' WHEN 'OO' THEN '해상수출' END AS BOUNDENG , info.LOGISTICS_CODE
, CASE WHEN info.LOGISTICS_CODE IN ('ICN','KRINC') THEN '인천' WHEN info.LOGISTICS_CODE = 'KRPTK' THEN '평택' WHEN info.LOGISTICS_CODE = 'KRPUS' THEN '부산' WHEN info.LOGISTICS_CODE = 'KRKUV' THEN '군산' END AS LOGISTICS_NAME , info.TRACKING_KOREX_YN , info.KOREX_ID , info.KOREX_CUST_ID , info.SENDER_TELNO1 , info.SENDER_TELNO2 , info.SENDER_TELNO3 , info.SENDER_ZIPCODE , info.SENDER_ADDR , info.SENDER_ADDR_DTL , info.SENDER_INFO_USEYN , info.TRACKING_EMS_YN , info.EMS_ID , info.TRACKING_EPOST_YN , info.EPOST_AUTH_KEY , info.EPOST_OFFICE_SER , info.EPOST_APPR_NO , info.EPOST_SECURITY_KEY , info.EPOST_CUST_NO , info.TRACKING_COPAS_YN , info.TRACKING_SMART_YN , info.FTP_PASSIVEMODE , info.FTP_TYPE , info.FTP_IP , info.FTP_PORT , info.FTP_ID , info.FTP_PW , info.FTP_SENDER_DIR , info.FTP_RECEIVER_DIR , info.TRACKING_LOGEN_YN , info.LOGEN_FREIGHT , info.LOGEN_PRICE , info.LOGEN_ID , info.LOGEN_PW , info.TRACKING_CHUNIL_YN , info.TRACKING_HANJIN_YN , info.HANJIN_CUS_NUM , info.HANJIN_ZIPCODE , info.HANJIN_ADDR1 , info.HANJIN_ADDR2 , info.HANJIN_NAME , info.HANJIN_TEL , info.HANJIN_MOBILE , info.HANJIN_CLIENT_ID , info.HANJIN_API_CODE , info.USE_YN , info.REG_ID , info.REG_DATE , info.UPD_ID , info.UPD_DATE , info.EPOST_DELIV_AREA_KEY ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = info.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = info.REG_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = info.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = info.UPD_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , info.TRACKING_LOTTE_YN , info.LOTTE_AUTH_KEY , info.LOTTE_CUST_ID , info.LOTTE_ZIPCODE , info.LOTTE_ADDR , info.LOTTE_BOX_TYPE , info.LOTTE_MOBILE , info.LOTTE_NAME , info.LOTTE_TEL FROM TB_SMS_DELIVERY_COMP_INFO info WHERE info.ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND info.BOUND = #{srchBound} AND info.CUSTOMER_CODE = #{srchCustomerCode} AND info.LOGISTICS_CODE = #{srchLogisticsCode}

/* SystemMngMapper.selectTemplateDataList : 알림톡 템플릿에 들어갈 파라메터 조회 */ SELECT od.ENT_CODE , od.SHIPPER_NAME , CASE ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC, '') WHEN '' THEN od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ELSE od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC END CONSIGNEE_NAME , od.HBL_NO
, od.OD_JOB_NO , od.OB_DATE
, od.ORIG_CODE , od.ORIG_NAME , od.DEST_CODE , od.DEST_NAME , (CONVERT(VARCHAR ,od.AR_DATE,23) + ' ' + od.AR_TIME) AS AR_DATE , od.CONSOL_YN , od.SHIPPER_TEL , odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS , (CONVERT(VARCHAR ,od.OB_DATE,23) + ' ' + od.OB_TIME) AS OB_DATE
, (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE GROUP_CODE = 'EDI_BONDED_WAREHOUSE' AND Code = od.ASSIGNMENT_WH_CODE) AS WHName
, (SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE GROUP_CODE = 'EDI_BONDED_WAREHOUSE' AND Code = mod.ASSIGNMENT_WH_CODE) AS WHName
, odAdd.CARRYIN_DATE , odAdd.CARRYOUT_DATE , odAdd.CLEARANCE_RECEIPT_DATE , od.COMMODITY_ITEM , odAdd.DELIVERY_RECV_DATE , odAdd.DELIVERY_DATE , od.ORIG_COUNTRY , od.DEST_COUNTRY , od.TR_NAME , od.DELIVERY_NAME_CHANGED , odAdd.CUSTOMS_ID_VERIFY , od.CB_NAME
, (SELECT RECV_DATE_TIME FROM TB_SMS_ALARM WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND REF_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND SOLUTION = 'ECM' AND JOB_TYPE = #{templateType}) AS RECV_DATE_TIME
, ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC, od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS) AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS , od.VESSEL_FLIGHT , od.DELIVERY_FEE , od.DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE , od.BOUND
,CASE ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, '') WHEN '' THEN dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) ELSE dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) END AS CONSIGNEE_HP ,CASE ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, '') WHEN '' THEN dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) ELSE dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) END AS CONSIGNEE_TEL ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CUSTOMS_ID_ENC, 1) AS CUSTOMS_ID
,CASE ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_HP, '') WHEN '' THEN od.CONSIGNEE_TEL ELSE od.CONSIGNEE_HP END AS CONSIGNEE_HP ,CASE ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_HP, '') WHEN '' THEN od.CONSIGNEE_TEL ELSE od.CONSIGNEE_HP END AS CONSIGNEE_TEL , od.CUSTOMS_ID
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL odAdd ON od.OD_JOB_NO = odAdd.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD mod ON mod.OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO
WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND od.HBL_NO IN(#{item})
AND od.BOUND = 'AIR' AND od.BOUND = 'SEA'
AND od.BOUND_TYPE = 'IMP' AND od.BOUND_TYPE = 'EXP'
AND od.CONSOL_YN = #{srchConsolYn}
AND odAdd.PRINT_YN = #{srchPrintYn}
AND odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS = #{srchStatus}
AND od.CD_TYPE = #{srchCdType}
AND odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS = 'ECM040'
AND ${srchDateGbn} BETWEEN #{srchStartDate} + ' 00:00:00' AND #{srchEndDate} + ' 23:59:00'
AND ISNULL(odAdd.CUSTOMS_ID_VERIFY, '') = 'Y'
AND ISNULL(odAdd.CUSTOMS_ID_VERIFY, '') IN ('N','X')
AND (ISNULL(odAdd.CUSTOMS_ID_VERIFY, '') = 'X' OR ISNULL(od.CUSTOMS_ID, '') = '')
AND ISNULL(odAdd.CUSTOMS_ID_VERIFY, '') = 'E'
AND ISNULL(odAdd.CUSTOMS_ID_VERIFY, '') = 'O'
AND ISNULL(odAdd.CUSTOMS_ID_VERIFY, '') = ''
AND od.CUSTOMS_ID_ENC != ''
AND ISNULL(od.CUSTOMS_ID, '') != ''
AND ${srchNoType} LIKE CONCAT('%',#{srchNo},'%')
AND #{srchCustomerCode} = od.CUST_CODE_LV${srchLoginCustomerUpperLev}
AND 1 = 0
AND #{srchCustomerCode} = od.CUST_CODE_LV${srchLoginCustomerLowLev}
AND 1 = 0
AND (SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV${srchLoginCustomerUpperLev}) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{srchCustomerName},'%')
AND 1 = 0
AND (SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV${srchLoginCustomerLowLev}) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{srchCustomerName},'%')
AND 1 = 0
